# Power Transmission Laser (PTL)
The Power Transmission Laser (PTL) is an engineering machine that converts excess station power into station funds by beaming the energy away. It is designed to be connected to the stations [color=orange]HV power[/color] network.
The PTL can be built from a machine frame using a PTL machine board (Machine circuit locate in Chief Engineer locker) and the required machine parts.
If the stations power network cannot keep up, the PTL will not run efficiently (and may stop until enough power is available).
## Setup
- 1. Place the PTL in a suitable location and connect it to the stations [color=orange]HV wire[/color]. - 2. Ensure the station has enough generation and storage to support the extra load ([color=red]Keep in mind that PTL will consumes 1 MW for charging internal reserve battery in any case[/color]). - 3. Use the PTLs UI to enable it.
## Interface
The PTL UI provides several useful indicators:
- Reserved power, which shows how much of the reserved battery is currently filled. - Grid saturation, that indicates how "stressed" the connected power network is.
## Where the money goes
Earnings are deposited into the stations bank account.
If an Engineering cargo ordering console account is available on the station, it is preferred, otherwise the Cargo account is used.
